About Us

Named one of the best cybersecurity startups, we're growing — and we want you to join our team.

Founded in 2020, Cyolo has quickly grown to become an award-winning company and emerging leader in the cybersecurity industry, recognized as one of the best startups to work for in the Duns 100 for 2025.

Headquartered in Tel Aviv and with team members located across Israel, the United States, the UK, Germany, and Belgium, we’re always looking for new talent to join our team.

Cyolo secures every connection across OT, cyber-physical systems (CPS), and critical infrastructure.
